text: So, I heard your relationship with Penny crashed to the ground like blue ice falling out of an airplane lavatory.

text: I thought it was a pretty good one, I gave him an L-O-L. Anyway, it got me thinking, now that you're unattached maybe we can revisit our previous attachment.

text: Are you suggesting another bout of stress release.

text: No, I'm all done with casual sex. From now on I'm fully committed to the traditional relationship paradigm.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Really, what changed?

speaker: leslie_winkle
text: It's hard to say, I guess there's just a time in every woman's life when she gets tired of waking up on a strange futon with a bunch of people she doesn't know.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Yeah, I can see how that would... a bunch of people?

text: Anyway, I just figure it's time to slow things down and who better to slow things down with than you?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Oh, I'm flattered. So, how do you suggest we proceed?

text: Your place, we'll order Chinese, you'll rent a movie, artsy but accessible, then light petting, no coitus.

text: Sounds fun.
